themes.name: Help output formatting and text wrapping
Customisable help page system (design and docs)
Terminal utilities and parameter types (edit, pager, prompt, Path)

duplicates.reason: Both report that the usage line wraps a hyphenated name (option or argument metavar) at its hyphen, because textwrap uses break_on_hyphens.
Both ask Click to add '...' to the metavar of options with multiple=True, so help shows that the option can be repeated.

top_issues.reason: Bug report: click.edit fails about half the time on Windows with WinError 87/14001. It needs a maintainer to decide whether the cause is in Click or in Windows.
Bug with a clear reproduction and a known cause: usage lines wrap names at hyphens. User reports in 90101 show it is confusing people.
Tracking issue for the Click 9.0 release, which holds the deprecation removals and API cleanup.
A long-standing help formatting bug (single newlines can't be kept) with a suggested fix in 3016.
Design for the customisable help formatter. Several help output requests depend on it, including 3652, 2778 and 2881.

records.judge_reason: Most themes broadly match the labelled ones: help formatting, help customisation, Click 9.0, docs, and terminal utilities. There are several errors. #3022 (colour env vars) is placed under help formatting instead of terminal utilities. #2992 is moved out of the help customisation API theme. The labelled parameter types theme is dissolved: #3888 is merged into terminal utilities, and #3036 is misplaced twice, in Click 9.0 and in Testing infrastructure. Testing infrastructure therefore mixes unrelated issues. #3696 and #3094 are each duplicated across two themes, so themes overlap. Several issues are misplaced and some themes overlap or mix topics, which puts this between 3 and 4.

themes.name: Help output, error messages, colour and i18n

duplicates.reason: Both report that a click.File(lazy=True) with a default file name that does not exist still fails at startup with 'No such file or directory', even when the file is never read. 2429 saw it only on Windows; 90111 does not name an OS.

top_issues.reason: A common completion style (--opt=value) is broken in both bash and zsh. In zsh the option text is overwritten. The issue has a clear reproduction and the expected behaviour.
Following the AliasedGroup example in the docs gives a traceback when a command name is mistyped during tab completion. There is a one-line fix for the docs or the code.
lazy=True does not stop the missing-file check for a File default, so the documented behaviour fails. It is the same problem as the long-open 2429.
get_parameter_source returns None for commands run through ctx.invoke or ctx.forward. This breaks downstream tools such as dbt, and another user has reported the same problem.
Default callbacks run during tab completion, which makes completion slow, and the resilient_parsing docs say this should not happen. This changed in 8.0.

records.judge_reason: Most report themes line up with the labelled ones, and splitting File/LazyFile into its own theme is coherent. Shell completion is mixed: #2853 (exception traceback on invalid parameter) and #2402 (resolve_command fails if cmd is None) have nothing to do with completion. #2783 (dynamic parameters on contexts) sits in parsing when it is about context. The context theme correctly holds #2753 and #2801, and adds #2493, which is reasonable. The help/output theme is a catch-all: help formatting and colour are fine, and the two ClickException items fit, but i18n (#2706), embedding with custom streams (#2361) and the project opinions meta issue (#2823) are unrelated additions. The errors and Click 9.0/internals themes are dissolved. So several themes are coherent, while two mix unrelated issues.

duplicates.reason: Both report that with chain=True an option placed after a subcommand's argument is not recognised, and both show the same minimal example.
Both report that confirmation prompts read from piped stdin instead of the terminal, so the user cannot answer them.

top_issues.reason: Chained commands reject options placed after arguments, which goes against the docs. It has a duplicate report (#90121) and needs either a fix or a docs change.
A clear bug with a reproduction: ctx.obj is None during shell completion and the completer crashes. A maintainer has said they will accept a PR.
A regression since Click 6.0: an unknown subcommand starting with '/' shows help instead of an error. The report names the commit that caused it.
Async support is the most discussed open feature request (23 comments), and #2360 is related to it.
click.confirm fails when input is piped in. Users keep hitting this, it duplicates #304, and someone has offered to open a PR.

records.judge_reason: The report covers all issues and its groupings are mostly coherent, though they differ from the labelled structure. Matches: the shell completion theme matches, with #1574 moved in, which is defensible since it is about context params. The terminal I/O theme mostly matches, but #1378 (atomic file) sits there instead of with types. The help theme matches, with #944 merged in from errors, which is reasonable. Differences: the report splits async (#2033, #2360) and the parser rewrite (#2205, #590) into their own themes. Those are coherent but break up the labelled themes. Its large 'Argument parsing & chained/sub-commands' theme is a broad grab-bag. It merges command and context issues with parameter-type issues (#928, #1428) and the error customisation issue #531, so it is less distinct. Several themes match and the others are mostly coherent, but some issues are misplaced and there is a vague catch-all theme, so this falls between 3 and 4.
